summary: argenx SE filed a Form 6-K attaching two October 8, 2026 press releases, the lead item being positive topline Phase 2 results for FB102, a first-in-class CD122 inhibitor, in adults with celiac disease. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled FB102-301 study enrolled 126 patients and met its primary endpoint of change from baseline in villus height-to-crypt depth ratio at day 78 versus placebo (p=0.0176), with supportive histologic, inflammatory and symptom measures and no new safety signals. argenx, which acquired Forte Biosciences in August 2026, plans Phase 3 development. This is a routine clinical-results disclosure, not a special situation.
